phy-dotenv-inheritance-mapper 1.0.1

- Updated metadata: new author "Canlah AI" and homepage URL
- Bumped version metadata to 1.0.1
- No functional or logic changes; documentation only

Initial release — maps and audits your full .env inheritance chain.

- Aggregates all .env files in project (e.g., .env, .env.local, .env.staging) and resolves the exact override order per framework.
- Shows the source file and effective value for every environment variable, flagging overrides and conflicts between environments.
- Identifies missing or extra variables in .env.example and variables referenced in code but missing from all .env files.
- Detects sensitive variables in non-gitignored files and highlights risky differences between staging and production.
- Works locally, with zero external API use, and supports any framework or language.
